Th ese deﬁ ciencies are due to general malabsorption, decreased 
production of hydrochloric acid that results in decreased
iron solubility, decreased intake of iron-containing foods, and 
decreased transport and storage protein synthesis.133–135 Often
these deﬁ ciencies are lifelong, respond poorly to treatment, and
result in subsequent complications.136, 137 Th ere is evidence that
long-term deﬁ ciency in bariatric surgery patients may increase
pica or disordered eating.138
